title: Starting a Direct-Payment Repayment Plan — Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery Contact Center Reference
content:
## Situation of use and capability

A repayment plan paid by direct payment starts on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** with its monthly installment, and the plan's first month is the calendar month after the month in which it starts.

A repayment plan's monthly installment is not fixed until the debt carries a repayment plan request received on the day the plan starts, stating the number of months the plan is to run.

In the same terms: the installment is set only once the debt's records hold a repayment plan request dated the day the plan starts that states the months the plan is to run.

The plan tool starts, on a verified caller's behalf, a repayment plan paid by monthly direct payments on one debt. One call puts the debt into repayment-plan status with the payment method set to direct payment, and records the approved monthly installment and the first plan month on the debt. The balance is not changed.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `start_repayment_plan_5152504c`. The representative unlocks it and calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `debt_id` | The reference number of the VA debt the plan is for, as shown on the debt record returned by the debt lookup for this debtor | Identifier text |
| `monthly_amount` | The approved monthly installment, in USD | A positive number with 2 decimal places, stored rounded half-to-even to the cent; passed at cent precision |
| `start_month` | The first plan month | Written YYYY-MM |

## Return

A successful call echoes the plan terms now on the debt: `debt_id`, `status` (always "repayment_plan"; this status means the plan is in effect), `repayment_plan_method` (always "direct_payment"), `repayment_plan_monthly_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `repayment_plan_start_month` (YYYY-MM).

## Hypothetical illustration

A plan that starts on 14 March 2027 has its first month in April 2027, so `start_month` is written 2027-04; the receipt shows `status` "repayment_plan" and `repayment_plan_method` "direct_payment".
